en.bdb: Parsu Ram remained devoid of the delight of the lotus feet

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਬਾਹੁ ਜਮਦਗਨਿ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਾਹੁਣਚਾਰੀ ਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sahas baahu jamadhagan ghar hoi paraahunachaaree aaiaa|

en.bdb: A king named Sahasrbahu came to Jamadagni rishi as a guest.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਧੇਣੁ ਲੋਭਾਇ ਕੈ ਜਮਦਗਨੈ ਦਾ ਸਿਰੁ ਵਢਵਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: kaamadhen lobhai kai jamadhaganai dhaa sir vaddavaiaa|

en.bdb: Seeing wish-ful-filling cow with the rishi he became greedy and killed Jamdagni.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਿਟਦੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਕੈ ਰੇਣੁਕਾ ਪਰਸਰਾਮ ਧਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: piTadhee sun kai renukaa parasaraam dhaiee kar dhaiaa|

en.bdb: Hearing the wails of Renuka, his mother, Parana Ram came running to her.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕੀਹ ਵਾਰ ਕਰੋਧ ਕਰਿ ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਖਤ੍ਰ ਗਵਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: eikeeh vaar karodh kar khatree maar nikhatr gavaiaa|

en.bdb: Becoming full of anger he cleared this earth of the kshatriyas twenty-one time i.e. he killed all the kashatriyas.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣਿ ਫੜਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਖੜਗੁ ਉਚਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: charan saran faR ubare dhoojai kisai na khaRag uchaiaa|

en.bdb: Only those who fell at the feet of Parasu Rim were saved; none else could raise arms against him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਸਕੀਆ ਚਿਰੰਜੀਵ ਹੁਇ ਆਪੁ ਜਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: haumai maar na sakeeaa chira(n)jeev hui aap janaiaa|

en.bdb: He also could not obliterate his ego and though he became chiraiijiv i.e. ever living person,
He always made show of his ego and could never receive the pollen of the lotus feet (of Lord).
